🎬 Branching Out (2024)

Branching Out follows Amelia, a devoted single mother raising her ten-year-old daughter, Ruby, who was conceived through IVF. When Ruby receives a school assignment to create a family tree, she becomes curious about her biological father and the family she has never known. Determined to help her daughter discover her roots, Amelia tracks down T.J., a kindhearted musician who was Ruby’s sperm donor. As T.J. welcomes Amelia and Ruby into his life, they are introduced to his warm and loving extended family, creating unexpected connections and meaningful relationships. While Ruby experiences the joy of discovering a new side of her family, Amelia finds herself developing romantic feelings for T.J. and questioning what her future might look like. Starring Sarah Drew and Juan Pablo Di Pace, the film delivers heartwarming storytelling about motherhood, romance, belonging, second chances, and the beautiful ways families can come together.

🎭 Genre: Romance • Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 1h 24m • TV-G

🎥 Director: Maclain Nelson

🎬 Production: Hallmark Channel

📺 Where to Watch: Hallmark+ and Amazon Prime Video (United States; availability may vary).
